item.title: Abandoned (& ticketed) vehicle in CPZ parking bay, 4th August
item.description:
30.7.26 reported to Haringey Council (as usual, zero action on their part). This dented/rusty vehicle (as per pic) has been abandoned in the CPZ parking bay on Priory Rd near the tennis courts. The vehicle has received parking tickets but as it is abandoned, these tickets are not a deterrent and the vehicle needs to be seized. I pay £280 per year for a CPZ parking permit for the *opportunity* to park in this bay as I have mobility issues and cannot walk any distance. This vehicle is taking up a valuable parking space and I have had to park further away in adjoining roads where walking back to my home has been painful and difficult. This parking bay, despite being a CPZ zone between 11am-1pm is very rarely enforced, the odd random ticket is put on a vehicle as a token gesture, but no active management or enforcement by the Council. This space needs to be made available quickly to those that pay for the use of this parking bay during the hours of 11am-1pm. Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 39, Priory Road, Hornsey, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: The whole of Harmsworth Street needs sweeping on both sides, 4th August
item.description:
It gets overlooked these days. It used to be swept a lot more regularly in the past. The are in and around the photo is a particular problem, especially between the parked trailer and the cycle hangar, also for litter and human waste including faeces and bottles of urine. People sit there in their cars at night to drink/eat, leave food cartons, bags, bottles and cans and treat the street like a public bin and toilet. If the street gets swept and looked after more regularly, I believe this problem might be reduces. Btw, we do litter pick ourselves at times, but there's only so much we can do. Thank you very much.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Harmsworth Street, Elephant and Castle, Greater London
